Types of suits every Indian girl should know!
Straight suit. Simple and elegant. Perfect for office.
Patiala. Lots of pleats in the salwar. Pure Punjabi swag!
Sharara. Pants that flare out from the knee. So festive!
Gharara. Gathered at the knee, then flared. A nawabi classic.
Palazzo suit. Wide, flowy pants. Comfy all day.
Churidar. Fitted pants that bunch at the ankles.
Angrakha. The kurta wraps, and ties at the side.
Dhoti suit. Draped dhoti pants. Fusion fun!
Afghani. Loose salwar, gathered at the ankles.
And the queen of them all... the Anarkali! Flared, and full of grace.
